battle.name: 俄國-波斯戰爭
battle.brief: 俄國-波斯戰爭於一八〇四年在南高加索爆發，波斯進攻俄屬喬治亞，戰線其後延伸至亞塞拜然與亞美尼亞；輪發手槍（Wheellock pistol）於一五〇〇年列裝，是歐洲陸軍早期制式火槍之一。戰事延續至一八一三年，最終條約重新劃定兩國的高加索邊界。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 以通常所稱1804年開戰、1813年以《古利斯坦條約》收束的俄波戰爭為準，1804年的主要交戰方是俄羅斯帝國所控制的卡爾特利－卡赫季及喬治亞輔助部隊，與卡扎爾伊朗及其在甘賈、沙基、德贊特等地的守軍和地方軍。戰區由第比利斯以東的博爾查利山道，越過阿拉斯河上游，延伸到庫拉河谷、亞塞拜然北部及西裡海沿岸；德贊特扼住山間缺口，基茲利亞爾控制通往卡扎爾腹地的道路。伊梅列蒂王國的所羅門二世站在俄方一邊，提供兵員與補給。英國沒有把使團併入俄軍：哈福德．瓊斯．布里奇斯率約四百名英軍及印度士兵，於1804年經波斯灣赴波斯，使團著重外交、軍事訓練及對法戰略合作，未參加阿斯蘭杜茲主戰鬥。因此，1804年秋季至1805年夏季的俄軍作戰，應視為俄羅斯與卡扎爾伊朗之間的戰爭，英方則是另行介入波斯的外交軍事力量。
countriesEn: Taking as the scope the Russo-Persian War commonly said to have begun in 1804 and to have ended with the Treaty of Gulistan in 1813, the principal belligerents in 1804 were the Russian Empire, which controlled the Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti, together with Georgian auxiliaries, on one side, and Qajar Iran with its troops and garrisons in Ganja, Shaki, Derbent, and other districts on the other. The theatre ran from the Borchali routes east of Tiflis, across the upper Araxes, into the Kura valley, northern Azerbaijan, and the Caspian coast. Derbent dominated a mountain passage, while Kizlyar commanded the road toward the Qajar heartland. Solomon II of the Kingdom of Imereti supported the Russians and supplied troops and provisions. Britain did not incorporate its mission into the Russian army. Harford Jones-Brydges led approximately four hundred British and Indian personnel to Persia through the Persian Gulf in 1804; the mission concentrated on diplomacy, military training, and strategic cooperation against France and did not fight at Aslanduz. The Russian operations from autumn 1804 through summer 1805 were therefore part of a war between Russia and Qajar Iran, while Britain acted through a separate diplomatic and military mission in Persia.
people: 俄軍實際指揮者是俄羅斯伯爵帕維爾．齊采尼诺夫，他出身喬治亞族裔家庭，自1802年起控制東喬治亞，並把野戰縱隊、騎兵、攻城炮列與後勤站分開調度；他在阿斯蘭杜茲負責正面作戰，其後則連續主持甘賈、德贊特、基茲利亞爾和沙基方向的攻勢。卡扎爾方面的戰場統帥是王儲阿拔斯．米爾札，即1825年即位的阿拔斯沙；他企圖以騎兵機動與舊式炮兵擾亂俄軍，卻在阿斯蘭杜茲失去陣地控制。德贊特守將胡賽因汗、沙基可汗裕瑟夫及所屬軍官負責應對包圍；亞歷克謝．薩莫伊洛夫則率領俄軍在裡海的小型划槳炮艇分艦，協同封鎖德贊特沿岸。英方代表哈福德．瓊斯．布里奇斯與熟悉波斯語言文化的威廉．奧斯利，負責使團外交及協助訓練波斯軍隊。齊采尼诺夫於1806年去世後，彼得．古多維奇接掌高加索俄軍，成為後續戰役的主要指揮者。
peopleEn: The effective Russian commander was Count Pavel Tsitsianov, an officer of Georgian family who had controlled eastern Georgia since 1802. He organized the field columns, cavalry, siege artillery, and supply stations separately, led the fighting at Aslanduz, and then directed the successive offensives toward Ganja, Derbent, Kizlyar, and Shaki. The Qajar field commander was Crown Prince Abbas Mirza, the future Shah Abbas, who sought to disrupt the Russians with cavalry maneuver and older artillery but lost control of his position at Aslanduz. Huseyn Khan, the garrison commander at Derbent, Yusef Khan of Shaki, and their subordinate officers handled the sieges. Alexey Samoylov commanded a small force of oared gunboats on the Caspian and assisted in blocking the coast below Derbent. On the British side, Harford Jones-Brydges and William Ouseley, who was versed in Persian language and culture, directed the mission's diplomacy and its work in training Persian troops. After Tsitsianov died in 1806, Count Peter Gudovich took command of the Russian forces in the Caucasus and led most of the subsequent campaigns.
kits: 截至1804年，俄軍步兵主要使用一七九六年式滑膛燧發步槍，配可與槍管固定的套筒刺刀；槍藥多以紙包分發，炮兵則使用六磅野炮為主、較重砲列及攻城採用十磅與十二磅滑膛炮。俄軍騎兵配彎刀，龍騎兵使用一七九七年式騎槍與手槍，頓河哥薩克另有騎槍、長矛和彎刀。波斯步兵常備札伊爾式長身火繩槍，另有數量較少的燧發槍，刺刀並未普遍裝配；卡扎爾騎兵使用彎刀、長矛、馬槍與盾牌，炮兵沿用口徑不一的舊式青銅或鑄鐵滑膛炮。英方英籍士兵使用Brown Bess燧發步槍及一七九六年式步兵劍，印度士兵則保留原建制的火繩槍或燧發槍。俄軍後勤以第比利斯為主要基地，靠車隊、馭獸和分段接力運糧，彈藥分裝木箱，備用火藥以桶儲存，飲水、飼料、馬匹補充與野戰醫療均隨軍列配置；過庫拉河時使用浮橋橋隊，重炮由炮組牽引。波斯遠征縱隊則依據大不里士、埃里溫及沿途軍械庫取得糧秣，騎兵通常自行攜帶數日份乾糧與弹药。
kitsEn: By 1804, Russian infantry principally carried the Model 1796 smooth-bore flintlock musket with a bayonet that fixed to the muzzle socket. Musket ammunition was generally issued in paper cartridges, while the artillery used six-pounder field guns, with ten- and twelve-pounder pieces serving in heavier columns and sieges. Russian cavalrymen carried sabres; dragoons used the Model 1797 carbine and pistol, while Don Cossacks also had carbines, lances, and sabres. Persian infantry commonly carried the long-bodied jazair matchlock, with fewer flintlock weapons and no universal issue of bayonets. Qajar cavalry used sabres, lances, horse pistols, and shields, while the artillery retained old bronze or cast-iron smoothbore guns of differing calibers. British soldiers used Brown Bess flintlock muskets and the Pattern 1796 infantry sword, while the Indian contingent retained matchlocks or flintlocks under its own system. Russian logistics were based principally on Tiflis, with food, ammunition, fodder, remounts, and field medical services carried forward by wagons, pack animals, and relay posts. Ammunition was carried in wooden boxes, reserve powder in barrels, and pontoon bridge trains were used to cross the Kura; heavy guns were moved by their gun teams. Persian expeditionary columns drew provisions and ammunition from Tabriz, Erivan, and regional depots, while cavalry commonly carried several days of food and ammunition on their own horses.
tactics: 阿斯蘭杜茲的作戰不是一條密集長線的單純碰撞。俄軍先以炮兵建立火力，步兵分批以營縱隊接近，騎兵分置兩翼，後方仍留有可調動的預備隊；波斯軍在開闊地上以步兵、騎兵和營帳周圍的炮位互相掩護，但一翼在俄軍正面壓力與側翼騎兵威脅下失去整齊配置，陣地及部分輜重區隨即被突破。齊采尼诺夫沒有讓全軍越過受損陣線追入山地，而是把主力轉向東面的甘賈。1804年9月21日至25日，俄軍包圍耶里斯韋特波爾，以野炮壓制城牆，步兵在掩體後接近並攻擊缺口，三日內迫使守軍放棄城池；兩日後又進入努哈。冬季向裡海推進時，俄軍把陸軍包圍與薩莫伊洛夫的炮艇封鎖配合，用於德贊特；基茲利亞爾則受到道路封鎖、攻城炮火與外勤巡邏的壓迫，守軍在突擊失敗後投降。1805年夏攻沙基堡壘時，俄軍再以約十日圍攻、炮火準備和步兵突進取城。這種由機動作戰轉向短期圍攻的節奏，受山路、冬季飼料和攻城器材供應制約，傷亡數字在不同戰報中差異很大，因此不宜用單一精確總數描寫。
tacticsEn: The fighting at Aslanduz was not the collision of a single dense line. The Russians opened with artillery, advanced infantry in battalion columns, placed cavalry on both wings, and retained a mobile reserve behind the first formations. The Persian army used infantry, cavalry, and artillery positions around its camp to give mutual cover on the open plain, but one wing lost its orderly formation under frontal pressure and the threat of Russian cavalry, after which part of the position and baggage area was penetrated. Tsitsianov did not send the entire army through the disordered front into the mountains; he turned the main body eastward toward Ganja. From 21 to 25 September 1804, the Russians besieged Elisavetpol, brought field guns against the walls, covered infantry approaches, and attacked the gaps until the garrison abandoned the city after three days. They entered Nukha two days later. During the winter advance to the Caspian, the Russians combined the land blockade with Samoylov's gunboats below Derbent. At Kizlyar, blocked roads, siege fire, and mobile detachments placed the garrison under increasing pressure, and it surrendered after an unsuccessful sortie. Against the fortress of Shaki in the summer of 1805, the Russians again used a siege lasting about ten days, artillery preparation, and an infantry assault. This shift from mobile battle to short sieges was governed by the mountain roads, winter fodder, and the supply of siege equipment. Casualty totals differ sharply among the reports, so no single exact figure can responsibly be used.
data: 本錄日期以現代格里曆表示；阿斯蘭杜茲的1804年9月18日，相當於俄方同期檔案的俄曆9月7日。戰前齊采尼诺夫在第比利斯集中軍隊，經博爾查利方向及庫拉河上游道路迎擊阿拔斯．米爾札。關於阿斯蘭杜茲，交戰一方常被記作約一萬二千名俄軍，另一方則約二萬至二萬五千名波斯軍；這些是不同軍籍與戰報形成的量級，並非同日點名。戰場在今亞美尼亞中部、埃里溫以北的阿拉斯河上游。9月18日俄軍取得戰場控制，9月21日至25日圍攻耶里斯韋特波爾，25日陷城，27日占領努哈。俄軍隨後利用庫拉河谷與希爾萬道路向裡海推進，1805年1月13日接受德贊特投降，2月22日取得基茲利亞爾，7月10日再以約十日圍攻取下沙基堡壘。齊采尼诺夫死後，戰事在1806年再度中斷，1807年6月古多維奇在賈瓦德擊退阿拔斯．米爾札的軍隊；1812年俄軍第二次進入阿斯蘭杜茲地區並取勝，9月21日占領甘賈，之後奪取卡爾斯、阿哈爾齊赫與埃里溫，1813年10月24日簽訂《古利斯坦條約》。以上是作戰與外交日期；雙方精確傷亡總數沒有可靠的一致記載。
dataEn: Dates here use the modern Gregorian calendar; 18 September 1804 at Aslanduz corresponds to 7 September in the contemporary Russian Old Style records. Before the battle Tsitsianov concentrated his army at Tiflis and moved through the Borchali direction and the upper Kura roads to meet Abbas Mirza. For Aslanduz, one side is commonly recorded as about 12,000 Russians and the other as roughly 20,000 to 25,000 Persians. These are orders of magnitude drawn from differing returns and battle narratives rather than a single common enumeration. The battlefield lay in the upper Araxes valley north of Yerevan in modern Armenia. The Russians gained control on 18 September, besieged Elisavetpol from 21 to 25 September, occupied the city on the 25th, and took Nukha on the 27th. They then advanced along the Kura valley and Shirvan routes toward the Caspian. Derbent capitulated on 13 January 1805, Kizlyar fell on 22 February, and the fortress of Shaki was taken on 10 July after a siege of about ten days. After Tsitsianov's death the war was interrupted in 1806, and in June 1807 Gudovich defeated Abbas Mirza's army at Javad. The Russians returned in 1812, won a second action in the Aslanduz area, occupied Ganja on 21 September, and afterward took Kars, Akhaltsikhe, and Erivan before the Treaty of Gulistan was signed on 24 October 1813. These are the operational and diplomatic dates; the sources do not support a single reliable set of exact casualty totals.
cause: 直接原因不是抽象的邊界爭執，而是喬治亞統治權與俄軍基地的實際衝突。1783年《格奥尔吉耶夫斯克條約》使卡爾特利－卡赫季成為俄羅斯保護國；1800年俄皇保羅一世又以公告把該王國併入帝國。卡扎爾君主阿加穆罕德汗於1801年攻入東喬治亞，扶立賈瓦德汗並削弱俄方影響，齊采尼诺夫則在1802年恢復俄羅斯對第比利斯及周邊據點的控制。1804年，阿拔斯．米爾札率波斯軍進入喬治亞方向，希望阻止俄軍把卡爾特利－卡赫季變成向亞塞拜然推進的跳板；俄方則要清除波斯軍在格魯吉亞的駐軍，並奪取通往庫拉河與裡海的道路。英國使團和法國在波斯的外交活動屬於更廣的國際背景：英方希望波斯在拿破崙戰爭中成為合作者，但沒有因此指揮俄軍，也没有把英國使團變成對卡扎爾的正式遠征軍。
causeEn: The immediate cause was not an abstract dispute over a frontier but a concrete conflict over Georgian government and Russian military bases. The 1783 Treaty of Georgievsk placed Kartli-Kakheti under Russian protection, and in 1800 Emperor Paul I proclaimed the kingdom part of the Russian Empire. The Qajar ruler Agha Mohammad Khan entered eastern Georgia in 1801, installed Javad Khan, and weakened Russian influence, while Tsitsianov restored Russian control over Tiflis and its surrounding positions in 1802. In 1804 Abbas Mirza moved a Persian army into the Georgian theatre, seeking to prevent the Russians from using Kartli-Kakheti as a springboard into Azerbaijan. Russia sought to remove the Persian military presence from Georgia and secure the routes toward the Kura and the Caspian. The British mission and French diplomacy in Persia formed part of the wider international background. Britain wanted Persian cooperation during the Napoleonic Wars, but it neither directed the Russian army nor turned its mission into a formal expeditionary force against the Qajars.
impact: 第一階段最直接的結果是卡扎爾在北高加索的攻勢被壓回，俄軍取得耶里斯韋特波爾、努哈、德贊特、基茲利亞爾與沙基堡壘。控制德贊特和基茲利亞爾後，俄國在西裡海沿岸獲得了向達吉斯坦、希爾萬和巴庫方向施壓的據點，阿拔斯．米爾札則失去亞塞拜然北部的主要兵源與軍用基地。喬治亞的政治地位也隨之改變：賈瓦德汗於1805年被廢，卡爾特利－卡赫季實際上被併入俄羅斯；所羅門二世仍保有伊梅列蒂王國形式，至1810年才完全落入俄國控制。卡扎爾朝廷並未因此覆亡，仍保有德黑蘭、大不里士與伊朗腹地，並利用英、法軍事顧問重建火槍隊、炮兵和後勤。英國由此獲得在波斯的外交與軍事入口，卻沒有靠直接參戰決定戰局。這些變化把1804年的局部勝利導向1806至1807年的再戰，以及1812至1813年更深的俄軍入侵。
impactEn: The most direct result of the first phase was that the Qajar offensive in the northern Caucasus was driven back. The Russians obtained Elisavetpol, Nukha, Derbent, Kizlyar, and the fortress of Shaki. Control of Derbent and Kizlyar gave Russia footholds on the western Caspian coast from which it could press toward Dagestan, Shirvan, and Baku, while Abbas Mirza lost major recruiting centers and military bases in northern Azerbaijan. Georgia's political position changed as well. Javad Khan was removed in 1805, and Kartli-Kakheti was effectively incorporated into Russia. Solomon II retained the formal Kingdom of Imereti until complete Russian control in 1810. The Qajar state did not collapse: it retained Tehran, Tabriz, and the Iranian interior, and used British and French military advisers to rebuild musketry, artillery, and logistics. Britain thereby gained a diplomatic and military foothold in Persia but did not decide the war through direct combat. These changes led from the local victory of 1804 to renewed fighting in 1806–1807 and the deeper Russian invasion of 1812–1813.
result: 就1804年秋季至1805年夏季的第一階段而言，結果是俄軍取得明確的戰場主動：阿斯蘭杜茲的野戰失敗使波斯軍失去主動權，隨後五處城塞的陷落又把戰線推至裡海；齊采尼诺夫因此能把卡爾特利－卡赫季牢固置於俄國控制之下。1804年的勝利並不是一場單獨戰爭的永久和平，俄波衝突仍曾中斷再起。齊采尼诺夫於1806年去世後，古多維奇接掌軍隊，1807年在賈瓦德再勝；1812年俄軍重返南高加索，第二次阿斯蘭杜茲戰鬥後占領甘賈、卡爾斯、阿哈爾齊赫和埃里溫。1813年10月24日《古利斯坦條約》結束主要戰事，俄國取得或確認對達吉斯坦、希爾萬、卡拉巴赫、甘賈及巴庫方向的控制，並鞏固其對東喬治亞的佔領，伊朗則保住德黑蘭、大不里士、伊斯法罕等核心地區。卡扎爾國家並未消失，阿拔斯．米爾札後來成為國王，並在1826至1828年再次對俄作戰。整體而言，1804年第一階段是俄軍對波斯軍的明確軍事與戰略勝利，而1813年的結果則是俄國在高加索取得長期優勢、卡扎爾伊朗仍能延續的雙重局面。
resultEn: For the first phase from autumn 1804 through summer 1805, the result was clear Russian control of the field. The Persian defeat at Aslanduz removed the initiative from Abbas Mirza, and the fall of five fortified towns carried the front to the Caspian. Tsitsianov was thereby able to place Kartli-Kakheti securely under Russian control. The victory of 1804 did not, however, create a permanent peace or constitute the end of the wider war. After Tsitsianov died in 1806, Gudovich took command and won again at Javad in 1807. The Russians returned to the southern Caucasus in 1812, won a second action in the Aslanduz area, and occupied Ganja, Kars, Akhaltsikhe, and Erivan. The Treaty of Gulistan on 24 October 1813 ended the principal hostilities. Russia obtained or confirmed control over Dagestan, Shirvan, Karabakh, Ganja, and the approaches to Baku, while reinforcing its occupation of eastern Georgia. Iran retained Tehran, Tabriz, Isfahan, and the other central provinces of its realm. The Qajar state did not disappear: Abbas Mirza later became Shah and fought Russia again in 1826–1828. In sum, the first phase of 1804 was an unambiguous Russian military and strategic victory, while the settlement of 1813 left Russia with a durable advantage in the Caucasus and the Qajar state still capable of continuing.
